Game Overview

Huggy Kissy vs Steve Alex is a monster title where dive into a heart-pounding escape as Steve and Alex evade Huggy and Kissiy. Collect three potions to activate your only way out through a portal. With simple yet thrilling two-player mechanics, communication and speed are key in this adrenaline-fueled chase with retro pixel vibes.
